test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Sikhs celebrate the day of release from prison (Bandi Chhor Diwas) with which of these Hindu festivals?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Diwali.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer is option 3, i.e., Diwali.
 
• The Sikh community celebrates Bandi Chhor Divas on the same day as Diwali.
 
• Ganesh Chaturthi is a Hindu festival celebrated in honour of Lord Ganesha.
 
• Holi is a Hindu festival of colours and is celebrated in the month of March.
 
• Dussehra is a Hindu festival celebrated to mark the victory of good over evil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sikhism is a monotheistic religion founded in the 15th century in Punjab, India. The religion is based on the teachings of Guru Nanak and nine other Sikh gurus who followed him.**
 
• Bandi Chhor Divas is a Sikh festival that marks the release of **Guru Hargobind Sahib from the Gwalior Fort along with 52 other Rajput kings.**
 
• Diwali is a Hindu festival of lights that celebrates the **victory of light over darkness, good over evil, and knowledge over ignorance**.
 
• Ganesh Chaturthi is a ten-day festival that celebrates the birth of Lord Ganesha, the elephant-headed god of wisdom and prosperity.
 
• Holi is a festival of colours that marks the arrival of spring and the victory of good over evil.
 
• Dussehra is a Hindu festival that celebrates the victory of Lord Rama over the demon king Ravana.
 
• Hence, the statement 3 is correct.
